text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim against self-driving cars","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a recognizable position early so the reader knows what the essay is arguing."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on cost, technology failure, and legal liability","quality":"argument development","description":"It develops several separate reasons against driverless cars instead of relying mainly on questions and general concerns."},{"evidence":"quoted article details with explanation","quality":"use of evidence","description":"It brings in specific facts from the source article and connects them to the writer's point."},{"evidence":"structured transitions like 'To begin,' 'To continue,' 'Next,' and 'To conclude'","quality":"organizational control","description":"It uses a more deliberate essay structure that makes the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"counterargument language such as 'Some may argue' and 'Opposers think'","quality":"counterargument awareness","description":"It acknowledges opposing views and responds to them rather than only stating one-sided objections."}]}
